convergence_criteria.if_failed: N is NOT increased after seeing 2025; a failed criterion on the burned sample before the freeze may raise N (re-registered) - never after
convergence_criteria.method: CDF / Wasserstein-1 stability for lattice outcomes (the NFL quantile R11 criterion is NOT used)
convergence_criteria.pass_rule: median over series of normalised W1 <= 0.03 AND 95th percentile <= 0.10 AND 95th percentile of KS <= 0.06; series with sd = 0 are exempt
convergence_criteria.procedure: for a deterministic sample of team-games (every 10th validation game of burned fold D4) simulate TWICE with N = 4000 and independent seeds; for every output series (team plays / rush / attempts / points, and every candidate's carries, rushing yards, receptions, receiving yards, attempts, completions, passing yards, TD counts) compute W1(CDF_a, CDF_b) / sd(pooled draws) and the KS distance

registered_before: the full integrated development run and the 2025 confirmation

simulation_N.seed_rule: seed = 1000 * season + game ordinal (sorted game keys); fixed, deterministic
